LESSON: POLYGAMY IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.4: Polygamy in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Polygamy in Islam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the rationale for polygamy in Islam?

1. explain the reasons for polygamy in Islam for social stability

3. appreciate the Islamic concept of polygamy as a social remedy to safeguard human dignity
